entities.name: Miroslav Wlachovský
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miroslav Wlachovský is a Slovak diplomat. He served as the Minister of Foreign and European Affairs of Slovakia from May to October 2023. Previously he served as Slovak ambassador to the United Kingdom from 2011 to 2015 and to Denmark from 2018 to 2022.
